title: Document Setup
instruction: Set page size to A4, portrait orientation and 2 cm margins.

title: Font Formatting
instruction: Apply the specified font family and size to the complete document.

title: Text Emphasis
instruction: Apply bold, italic and underline to the indicated phrases.

title: Paragraph Alignment
instruction: Set the title to centre alignment and body paragraphs to justified.

title: Line Spacing
instruction: Set body paragraphs to 1.5 line spacing.

title: Paragraph Indentation
instruction: Apply first-line indentation to each body paragraph.

title: Paragraph Spacing
instruction: Set 6 pt spacing after body paragraphs.

title: Bulleted List
instruction: Convert the marked lines into a bulleted list.

title: Numbered List
instruction: Convert the marked steps into a numbered list.

title: Multilevel List
instruction: Create a two-level numbered list from the outline.

title: Find and Replace
instruction: Replace every occurrence of the given word with its replacement.

title: Header
instruction: Insert the supplied text in the document header.

title: Footer
instruction: Insert the supplied footer text and align it right.

title: Page Number
instruction: Insert page numbers in the footer.

title: Page Border
instruction: Apply a simple box page border.

title: Text Highlight
instruction: Highlight the specified key terms.

title: Font Colour
instruction: Change the specified heading to the required font colour.

title: Change Case
instruction: Convert the selected heading to uppercase.

title: Columns
instruction: Format the selected notice text into two columns.

title: Section Break
instruction: Insert a section break before the second section.

title: Table Creation
instruction: Create a table with the specified rows and columns.

title: Table Formatting
instruction: Apply borders and header-row emphasis to the table.

title: Cell Alignment
instruction: Centre-align the contents of the selected table cells.

title: Cell Merge
instruction: Merge the indicated cells in the first table row.

title: Row Height
instruction: Set the specified table row height.

title: Column Width
instruction: Adjust the table columns to the supplied widths.

title: Insert Picture
instruction: Insert the supplied picture at the marked location.

title: Picture Wrapping
instruction: Set the picture text wrapping as instructed.

title: Hyperlink
instruction: Create a hyperlink using the supplied display text and address.

title: Footnote
instruction: Insert a footnote at the indicated sentence.

title: Page Break
instruction: Insert a page break before the next heading.

title: Watermark
instruction: Apply the supplied text as a document watermark.

title: Styles
instruction: Apply Heading 1 and Heading 2 styles to the marked headings.

title: Navigation Pane
instruction: Use heading styles so the document outline is navigable.

title: Tab Stops
instruction: Set a right-aligned tab stop for the listed values.

title: Drop Cap
instruction: Apply a drop cap to the first paragraph.

title: Text Box
instruction: Insert a text box containing the supplied notice.

title: Shapes
instruction: Insert and format the specified basic shape.

title: Mail Merge
instruction: Prepare a simple letter using the supplied recipient fields.

title: Spelling Review
instruction: Run spelling review and correct the marked errors.

title: Document Properties
instruction: Set the document title and author properties.

title: Print Layout
instruction: Verify page layout and remove unwanted blank pages.

title: Table of Contents
instruction: Insert a table of contents from the heading styles.

title: Track Changes
instruction: Enable Track Changes and make the specified edit.

title: Comments
instruction: Add a comment to the marked sentence.

title: Page Orientation
instruction: Change only the specified section to landscape.

title: Different First Page
instruction: Enable a different first-page header/footer.

title: Text Direction
instruction: Set the selected table cell text direction.

title: Sort Table
instruction: Sort the table records by the specified column.

title: Final Formatting
instruction: Apply consistent heading, body and page formatting.
